headline: Minda Corporation acquires further shares in Spark Minda Green Mobility Systems under right issue
sum: Minda Corporation has announced acquisition of additional shares in its wholly-owned subsidiary (WOS) Spark Minda Green Mobility Systems Private Limited through a right issue. The transaction signals continued capital deployment in the subsidiary's green mobility initiatives.
detail: Minda Corporation, a listed automotive components and systems manufacturer, has disclosed a material acquisition of further shares in its wholly-owned subsidiary Spark Minda Green Mobility Systems Private Limited under a right issue mechanism. The right issue structure suggests a pro-rata capital raise within the subsidiary, with the parent acquiring its proportionate entitlement to maintain or increase its ownership stake. No consideration amount was disclosed in the intimation. This transaction reflects the group's strategic focus on electric vehicle and green mobility component development.
